description: "Fanny, the Flower-Girl; or, Honesty Rewarded" by Selina Bunbury is a children's storybook likely written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The narrative centers around a young girl named Fanny, who sells flowers in the streets to support her sick grandmother.
